parts.heading: Who I am
body: I’m Manuel, a software developer from the Basel region. Since November 2021, I’ve worked at zvoove Switzerland AG on business software for staffing companies. I design and build Vue interfaces for complex workflows, develop PHP endpoints and help maintain integrations and data synchronisation.
I also take responsibility for a Cypress suite of around 30 extensive release tests, from writing and running tests to analysing failures. Migration to Playwright is in progress.

parts.heading: How I started
body: Gaming got me into programming: my own Minecraft modpack server and mining turtles in Lua were my first projects.
From 2016 to 2020, I completed an IT apprenticeship at Novartis. Servers, networks and support gave me a broad foundation. After civilian service, I moved into application development.

parts.heading: How I work with AI
body: I use Codex and Claude Code to build substantial projects of my own, with custom skills, agents and MCP integrations. I combine these tools with clear requirements, incremental implementation and tests.

I developed the club platform and this portfolio with AI assistance. My React and TypeScript experience comes from these projects; PHP and Vue are where I have deeper professional experience. I take care of the design, scope and ongoing operation.

parts.heading: What motivates me
body: I enjoy working on things people actually use. At the club, I see first-hand whether an interface makes sense and a workflow works. New technologies interest me most when they help me put a specific idea into practice.

parts.heading: Away from the screen
body: Wildlife and automotive photography, travel, skiing, snowboarding and diving are as much part of my life as development. At Jogge di Balla, I’m a co-founder and vice president and help with events, photography and video alongside the platform.

caseStudy.headline: A platform for our club’s daily work.
caseStudy.hook: I built a dedicated club and event platform for Jogge di Balla over several months. It combines the public website, internal administration and tools for events. I continue to develop and operate it.

context.label: My contribution
story: Co-founder and vice president since August 2022. Alongside events and media production, I take responsibility for the platform’s concept, design, development and operation.
Managing members and supporters, reporting attendance and sending orders to the kitchen and bar: the club uses these features regularly.

items.title: More than a club website
items.lede: Administration and event operations come together in the same platform.
items.screenshotAlt: Admin dashboard with permissions card and member list

features.title: Permissions and memberships
features.body: Configurable role permissions, supporting memberships with payment status and attendance reports reflect the club’s day-to-day needs.

features.title: Order and point-of-sale system
features.body: Orders for service, kitchen and bar with separate views and status workflows. Prices are determined on the server; orders retain their item data.

features.title: Media and events
features.body: Image processing and a moderated live slideshow complement event management, statistics and streaming tools.

items.title: «Schlag den Kassier» on stream
items.lede: One example of the event tools: an overlay brings scores and the club’s visual identity to the live stream.
items.screenshotAlt: Twitch overlay during stream with live score and club design

features.title: Browser-based control
features.body: A separate control panel manages the display, which is embedded in OBS as a browser source.

features.title: Synchronised scores
features.body: The overlay regularly fetches the latest scores and updates the display without reloading.

features.title: Supporting the game
features.body: Winner displays and calculations of when a lead becomes unbeatable help the presenters run the event.

reflection.label: Lessons Learned
reflection.body: The platform grew over several months and continues to evolve through everyday club use. The project includes automated tests and a rented Linux root server that I set up and administer myself.

photography.headline: Through the Lens.
photography.lede: Wildlife and cars are my two worlds. The first I chase solo through the jungles of Costa Rica or Thailand, the second usually find me closer to home. What connects them: patience, light, and that one moment that justifies the whole day.
